---
title: "Live App"
---

<!-- Set APP_URL in 00-master.R to display the deployed app here. -->

```{r}
#| echo: false
app_url <- Sys.getenv("PTI_APP_URL", unset = "")
if (nzchar(app_url)) {
  htmltools::tags$iframe(src = app_url, width = "100%", height = "800px")
} else {
  htmltools::p("App not yet deployed. Set APP_URL in 00-master.R and re-run the pipeline.")
}
```
